description:
Make a sound (a 48 kHz WAV in the account's audio files) from a recipe that R3 renders: layers of synth / fm / noise / sample sources, each with an envelope and effects (filter, distortion, bitcrush, delay, reverb, compressor, tremolo), and a master stage that can make a seamless LOOP. Nothing is uploaded and it is free (60 sounds an hour for each agent key or app connection).

Start from a preset (laser, coin, jump, explosion, click, whoosh, hit, power-up, helicopter-rotor, engine-hum) with optional overrides {seed, duration, channels}, or pass a full `recipe`: r3_docs_read("SOUND_RECIPES.md") has the format, every preset's recipe and worked examples. An invalid recipe is refused with the path of the problem.

You cannot hear it: the answer gives numbers (peak / RMS dBFS, clipping, silent tail, the loop seam check, warnings), the url an Audio component takes and a listen link for the user. Pass `attachTo` {projectId} to also add an Audio component playing it in that project (a loop loops and plays when the project runs; a one-shot is played from code). Names are unique per account.

attachTo.description: Also add an Audio component playing it: {projectId, name?, volume?, playOnStart?}.

name.description: The component's name. Default: the sound's name.

playOnStart.description: Plays when the project runs. Default: true for a loop, false for a one-shot (played from code).

projectId.description: The project to add an Audio component to (r3_project_list).

name.description: What the owner sees in their audio files, e.g. "Helicopter rotor". Unique in the account.

overrides.description: With a preset: {seed, duration, channels} (seed = another variation).

preset.description: A preset: laser, coin, jump, explosion, click, whoosh, hit, power-up, helicopter-rotor, engine-hum.

name: r3_sound_create

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Make a sound effect or seamless loop from a recipe
